goal: Deprecate encrypting existing wallets to prevent pre-encryption backup invalidation and fund loss
Avoid leaving plaintext key material behind on disk and altering spending conditions on imported descriptors
reviewability: Awaiting re-review following a clean rebase and minor documentation updates
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Supports deprecation because creating an encrypted wallet upfront is safer and cleaner (pablomartin4btc)
Concept approval without stated reasons (pseudoramdom, rkrux)
Reviewed and approved the test suite and deprecation changes (achow101, w0xlt)
Minor suggestions on documentation and release notes were addressed in the latest push (fanquake, maflcko)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because encrypting existing wallets creates new keys that can silently invalidate earlier backups
Protects user funds by avoiding silent changes to spending conditions on manually imported descriptors
Serves as a necessary prerequisite to completely removing post-creation wallet encryption
